summary: Define account runtime and identity graph standard

delivery.outcome: A provider-neutral standard for evidence-backed account graphs, isolated account runtimes, scoped MCP/CLI invocation and secret-free receipts.
nonGoals: Treat detected software or an auth profile as authenticated readiness
Grant an LLM, DSL document or container execution authority

architecture.decision: Separate observed identity/service evidence from externally authorized runtime bindings; address tools through typed account/provider/tool endpoints and never through raw shell input.
dataChanges: Introduce the experimental wellmanifest.account-runtime/v1 document family
architecture.rollback: Remove the five ticket-owned standard files while preserving the governed baseline and ticket evidence.
